risks.name: Further electrical supplier disruption
risks.impact_days: 3 to 9 per affected task, one shared event
risks.trigger: No confirmed dispatch slot at next supplier review
risks.mitigation: Reserve finishing slot, confirm dispatch evidence and maintain alternate logistics quote.

risks.name: Integrated test requires repeat work
risks.mitigation: Review entry criteria and diagnostic coverage before the test. Repeat testing remains mandatory after a failure.

risks.name: Dyno booking conflict
risks.impact_days: Calculated explicitly in the deterministic resource schedule
risks.trigger: Two assignments request Dyno A on the same working day
risks.mitigation: Protect one integrated slot and review the priority queue weekly.
risks.simulation: resource constraint, not a stochastic event

risks.name: Incomplete release evidence
risks.impact_days: Release remains blocked until evidence and approvals are complete
risks.trigger: Mandatory record lacks accepted status, reference or approver
risks.mitigation: Review evidence register weekly and assign an owner for each missing item.
risks.simulation: evidence gate, not assigned an invented probability

actions.action: Obtain a written finishing and dispatch commitment for both electrical demonstrators.
Confirm protected Dyno A reservations and the escalation route for a clash.
Validate the incremental recovery quote and avoid double-counting support costs.
Agree test entry criteria and retain acceptance scope across recovery options.
Assign submission dates for each missing mandatory record.
